description: Paired A/B of the rhythm layer (docs/rhythm/rhythm_spec.md, PRs #741/#742) on the sars_cov2 arm: the same takeoff-conditioned cells at the v12 admissible-band midpoint Theta = 2.37e11, rhythm.enabled false vs true, across all four real cruise classes. Arms are 'off' (labelled baseline: rhythm.enabled=false, the spec's claim of byte-identical draws) and 'on' (rhythm.enabled=true). Cells enumerate leg-major, then arm, then seed: mega_cruise occupies indices 0-39 (off 0-19, on 20-39), contemporary_cruise 40-79, classic_cruise 80-119, expedition_cruise 120-159.

cell_conditioning.note: Identical to TAKEOFF-ATTR-01 (docs/ledger/COVID-TAKEOFF-ATTR-01.md): declared replay on the record hulls, one import, infection_age_days 6.8, onset_day -1.0, departure_day 5.0, dwell_weighted sanitary visits, SOP-017 confinement days 16-30, 768 hourly epochs (mega/contemporary/classic), syndromic onset observation. Scenario legs inherit their records (expedition = greg_mortimer_2020: 28 days, SOP-017 8-27, the generic boarding axis per the v12 stage-3 convention - the held-out seed declares no onset day, so its incubation is drawn and the DP-particular ascertainment gate is dropped). Generic legs exist because the covid arm has no spirit/classic-class event record: they carry the DP index geometry verbatim on the platform's own complement - contemporary 2100 pax + 900 crew (nominal), classic 1332 pax + 560 crew (all passenger berths; the layout holds 1332 PC_ + 570 CC_ beds). Generic legs carry no testing_campaign (none exists for those classes) - recorded_onsets comes from the syndromic onset curve as on the record legs.
cell_conditioning.theta: 2.37e11 - v12 admissible-band midpoint; fixed, no re-screen

arms.note: labelled baseline; the byte-identity claim under test
rhythm layer deals daily itineraries from the class catalog

freeze.byte_identity_gate: Before any array: a takeoff-conditioned cell run with rhythm.enabled=false on the A/B SHA must be byte-identical (payload observables + full onset_curve + sanitary_activity) to the same spec run on the pre-#742 tree under the same interpreter; on AWS the off-arm canary must reproduce the stored stage-2 record of record for the same (theta, seed) cell. Any divergence halts the campaign.
freeze.attribution_criterion: Declared before runs (stochastic-attribution skill): an effect counts only if |on - off| exceeds the paired-seed spread of the off arm for the same class on both reporting seeds; challenged_share_of_aboard and per-epoch dosed-set quantiles are the primary exposure-set metrics; route re-split is read off by_infecting_epoch_dose.
metrics: onset count distribution + clause ratio vs ~197 + before_share (recorded_onsets, observables.onsets_before_split_day / recorded_onsets, target 0.173 +/- 0.10, takeoff seeds >= 10 recorded onsets, clause needs >= 5 takeoff seeds)
clock correlation: rhythm_ab.occupancy_sync_corr (point-biserial r, transit-zone occupancy vs catalog synchronized-end epochs) + occupancy_lift_at_sync_end
class scoping: rhythm_ab.crew_zone_passenger_epochs and crew_zone_passenger_challenges must be 0 under the on arm
anchors: takeoff gate (takeoff seeds among recorded>=10), H1-H3 hull placements, MIDRS/A8 where in scope - scored not shaped
report_immediately_if: byte-identity gate fails or the flag is inert (metrics do not move)
challenged_share_of_aboard stays 1.0 under the on arm (co-presence partition broken)
crew-only zones show passenger exposure epochs under the on arm (class scoping broken)
freeze.non_goals: No Theta re-screen; no participation-fraction sweeps; no register edits; no mechanism fixes - filed, not fixed; naval/starship hulls out of scope.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot per .agents/skills/aws-batch-campaign/SKILL.md; deploy/aws/submit_covid_rhythm_ab.sh; jobdef revision + image digest pinned per campaign-preflight, never a bare tag
execution.canary: indices 0 and 20 via --index (mega/off/seed-20200205 and its on pair): off must byte-match the stored stage-2 record for the same (theta, seed); on must move the claimed metrics. Then the four class arrays.
